lines.service: Genetic expression profiling test for breast cancer - 81519

remarks: CO-55: Reason for denial: The genetic expression profiling test for breast cancer is considered experimental or investigational for your condition under our medical policy.
appeal: This is not a bill. To ask us to reconsider, write to Hollis Creek Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 97330, Toledo, OH 43604. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-3523.
